name: zvideo_dd3d_convert_image_pixels_for_texture
description: zVideo_dd3d::ConvertImagePixelsForTexture converts 16-bit zVid image pixels into the active Direct3D texture upload pixel format.
known_limits: VC5SP3 target zvideo_dd3d_convert_image_pixels_for_texture currently fails for 0x4aa6f0 with 362 unmasked byte mismatches, 20 relocation-masked bytes, and 5 trimmed VC NOPs after recovering field-based width/height loop bounds; remaining tier S work is source-shape repair for the pixel-conversion loop register and branch structure.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aa6f0 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall dstPixels/image with pitchBytes on the stack, no use of the useAlpha argument, no direct callees, source pixels from image->pixels, row stepping by pitchBytes, signed width/height loop gates, and alpha-map selection solely from image->alphaMap.
For images without an alpha map, assembly validates blue-mask preservation, red/green mask packing through ((src >> 1) & ((rMask | gMask) >> 1)), and setting 0x8000 when the source pixel is nonzero.

For images with an alpha map, assembly validates alpha from (alphaByte & 0xf0) << 8, blue from (src >> 1) & (bMask >> 1), the 6-green-bit mask/shift pair red=0xf000>>4 and green=0x0780>>3, and the non-6-green-bit pair red=0x7800>>3 and green=0x03c0>>2.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4aa6f0 has no warning tags. The native smoke verifies 565 opaque conversion with pitch-row spacing, 565 alpha-map conversion, and a 555 alpha-map conversion while passing useAlpha=0 to prove the branch is driven by image->alphaMap.
